```{r}
#| label: setup

library(HH)
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)

```

```{r}
job_sectors <- read_csv("data/raw/job-sectors.csv")

polentometro_job <- readRDS("data/derived/polentometro.rds") |> 
  drop_na(educated, job_sector) |> 
  left_join(y = job_sectors) |> 
  select(CASE, educated:urban, job_5) |> 
  mutate(
    across(educated:urban, as.ordered),
    job_5_num = as.integer(factor(job_5, 
                                              levels = c("Primary", "Secondary", "Tertiary", "Quaternary", "Quinary")))
  )
```

```{r}
job_lik <- polentometro_job |> 
  select(job_5, educated:urban) |> 
  pivot_longer(educated:urban) |> 
  count(job_5, name, value) |> 
  group_by(job_5, name) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = value, values_from = n) |> 
  mutate(
    across(everything(), ~ifelse(is.na(.x), 0, .x))
  ) |> 
  relocate(`1`, `2`, .before = `3`) |> 
  select(-`NA`)

likert(
  name ~ . ,
  job_lik |> filter(job_5 == "Primary"),
  as.percent = TRUE,
  main = ""
)
likert(
  name ~ . ,
  job_lik |> filter(job_5 == "Secondary"),
  as.percent = TRUE,
  main = ""
)
likert(
  name ~ . ,
  job_lik |> filter(job_5 == "Tertiary"),
  as.percent = TRUE,
  main = ""
)
likert(
  name ~ . ,
  job_lik |> filter(job_5 == "Quaternary"),
  as.percent = TRUE,
  main = ""
)
likert(
  name ~ . ,
  job_lik |> filter(job_5 == "Quinary"),
  as.percent = TRUE,
  main = ""
)
```

```{r}
job_bm <- brm(
  mvbind(educated, friendly, funny, kind, modern, refined, rich, urban) ~ mo(job_5_num),
  data = polentometro_job,
  family = cumulative(link = "probit"),
  cores = 4,
  seed = 9123,
  file = "data/cache/job_bm"
)
```

```{r}
summary(job_bm)
```

```{r}
plot(conditional_effects(job_bm, categorical = TRUE), ask = FALSE)
```
